A coordination service name must contain the Coordination identifier.

Back to STXC rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A coordination service name must contain the Coordination identifier. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Coordination services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXC002: A coordination service name must contain the Coordination identifier.
class StudentService(IStudentOrchestrationService students) : IStudentService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXC002
class StudentCoordinationService(IStudentOrchestrationService students) : IStudentCoordinationService { }
